name: Skittering Dark
summary: Giant spiders now hunt through Skittering Dark and the nearby woods in western Silverpine. The abandoned mine and its approaches are dangerous to beasts and travelers alike.

sections.title: A Webbed Hollow
sections.body: East of North Tide's Run, Skittering Dark lies where the western coast meets the hills. The mine once worked, but now cobwebs choke its shafts and giant spiders nest through the hollow. Krethis haunts the shadowed woods outside. The spiders hunt anything that strays too close.

faq.answer: Skittering Dark lies abandoned in western Silverpine Forest, overrun by giant spiders. Webbing and predatory spiders fill its cavern network and the surrounding trees.

faq.q: Who leads the spiders in the mine?
faq.answer: No single ruler of the brood is known. Krethis Shadowspinner is the most feared spider, a rare and dangerous weaver that prowls in and around the mine.

faq.q: Where is the Skittering Dark located?
faq.answer: Skittering Dark lies in western Silverpine Forest, against the hills just east of North Tide's Run.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler in Silverpine, watch for spiders that ambush unwary prey straying from the surrounding woods into their webbed dens.
